headline: Invesco (IVZ) Stock Sees Fair Value Lift After Analysts Raise Targets
summary: Invesco’s updated fair value estimate has shifted from about US$29.96 to roughly US$32.79, which points to a higher price target in the latest round of research work. Analysts linking this change to recent Q2 flows, operating leverage potential, and the role of products such as QQQ are keeping ratings mostly steady but are adjusting where they think the stock now fits.
